newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas futures mixed, all eyes on winter.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas futures mixed, all eyes on winter.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures headed in mixed directions on Friday with trade confined to the upcoming winter months.
A total of 255 lots changed hands, with trade slowing up from Thursday's brisk pace which saw 540 lots trade.
All deals were done in the fourth quarter and January next year.
November was the only loser of the traded months, shedding 0.120 pence a therm to settle at 12.850 pence with 105 lots traded.
October ended 0.010 penny a therm higher, the lower end of its trading range on the over-the-counter market where it was heavily traded by one major shipper.
"The market isn't heading in any particular direction, we're just seeing a shake-out on individual months," a trader said.
The new balance of month contract was again untraded but ended the day 0.040 penny a therm up at 9.070 pence.
